name: tasks
description: The app's way into a Space's tasks: one tool per Store call over the kernel's task store, each under the caller's own chain in the Space it names. Nothing here decides; the kernel does.

tools.name: tasks.serve
tools.summary: a team member's task reads on the team's server, as that member in that Space (the daemon's member door only)

tools.name: tasks.serve-work
tools.summary: a team member works a task on the team's server, as that member in that Space (the daemon's member door only)

tools.name: tasks.serve-request
tools.summary: a team member asks for a task on the team's server, as that member in that Space (the daemon's member door only)
